Where expertise meets impact: join us and help shape Saxo’s global CRS and FATCA tax reporting.

About the Job

Saxo is seeking a Senior Tax Reporting Specialist to join our Global Tax Reporting team with a specific focus on CRS and FATCA reporting. In this role, you will play a crucial part in navigating the complex tax landscape, ensuring Saxo's compliance with CRS and FATCA regulations. You will drive activities across jurisdictions to ensure Saxo's compliance with relevant legislation, market practices, and internal rules.

At Saxo, we pride ourselves on fostering a growth-embracing culture. You thrive in a dynamic, ambitious, yet informal and welcoming work environment. We are committed to your personal and professional development, offering ample opportunities for career advancement. Work alongside the best in the industry and make a real impact.

Responsibilities

As our new Senior Tax Reporting Specialist, you will play a key role in ensuring accurate and compliant CRS and FATCA reporting, with a strong focus on data analysis, due diligence and reporting controls. You will work hands-on with large and complex data sets throughout the end-to-end reporting process and help ensure that reporting data is complete, accurate and ready for submission.

In addition, you will contribute to defining and maintaining reporting requirements and ensuring that reportable amounts and personally identifiable information (PII) data fields are correctly specified and delivered in the required formats.

Other responsibilities include:

• Preparing, analysing and validating large data sets used for CRS and FATCA due diligence and reporting.

• Performing due diligence activities, including generating, testing and validating data to identify inconsistencies, exceptions and potential reporting issues.

• Designing, implementing and maintaining data-driven controls and reconciliations to ensure completeness and accuracy throughout the reporting process.

• Investigating data discrepancies and reporting errors, identifying root causes and supporting their resolution.

• Developing and maintaining efficient Excel-based analyses, validation models and other tools supporting the reporting process.

• Acting as a frontrunner in identifying and implementing AI and automation opportunities across tax reporting processes, data analysis and controls, with the aim of reducing manual activities and improving efficiency, scalability and quality.

• Maintaining a comprehensive log of reporting errors and supporting mitigation and remediation activities.

• Working closely with technology and other stakeholders to translate reporting requirements into clear data and system requirements.

• Monitoring changes to reporting requirements and XML schemas and assessing their impact on data, controls and reporting processes.

• Delivering CRS and FATCA reports globally to high standards of completeness, accuracy and timeliness.

Your profile

We are looking for someone who enjoys working hands-on with data and investigating why numbers or data do not look as expected. You have a strong analytical mindset and are comfortable working with large and complex data sets, identifying patterns, exceptions and inconsistencies.

You are structured and detail-oriented, but also able to understand the bigger picture and translate regulatory requirements into practical data checks and controls. You take ownership of your work, enjoy solving complex problems and are motivated by continuously improving and automating processes.

You are also curious about how AI, automation and emerging technologies can improve the way tax reporting is performed, and you are motivated to take a leading role in identifying and implementing new solutions within the team.

Further:

• Relevant degree in accounting, finance, economics, data analytics, business administration or a related field, combined with strong practical experience in data analysis and reporting.

• Strong experience working with large and complex data sets and performing data analysis and validation.

• Experience designing or operating data controls, reconciliations and exception-based reviews.

• Advanced Excel skills, including experience building structured models using complex formulas, data validation and data transformation.

• Experience with Power BI, SQL or similar data analysis tools is a strong advantage.

• Strong interest in AI and automation and the ability to identify practical opportunities for applying new technologies to reporting processes and controls.

• Experience with financial, regulatory or tax reporting is an advantage.

• Experience with CRS and FATCA is a plus, but not a prerequisite if you have a strong data and reporting background.

• Strong problem-solving skills and an ability to investigate data issues systematically from identification through to root cause.

• Ability to communicate clearly and confidently in English, both verbally and in writing.

We get curious people invested in the world

When you work at Saxo, you become a Saxonian and part of a purpose-driven organisation, where good ideas are always taken seriously, and where you can make a true impact. We are invested in your development, and you can expect a robust career from day one when you join Saxo – no matter which role you take on.

Working in Saxo, you will get to meet colleagues from many different cultures and backgrounds, and you should know that we value diversity and inclusion and see it as a genuine source of strength to drive growth, foster innovation and position us for long-term success.

Do you thrive at the intersection of organizational leadership, platform engineering, and SaaS transformation? Are you motivated by building teams and shared capabilities that enable other engineers to move faster, operate with greater autonomy, and deliver at scale?

At Stibo DX, we are looking for an experienced Director of Platform Engineering to lead a strategically important engineering domain and drive our transition toward SaaS.

The role

As Director of Platform Engineering, you will lead three global teams responsible for Cloud Platform, Print Platform, and Content Delivery. Together, these teams provide shared platform foundations, deployment capabilities, gateway infrastructure, APIs, and supporting services used across the Cue media enterprise platform.

Your primary mission is to accelerate the SaaS transformation. You will develop the domain into a coherent platform-engineering organization that provides standardized, reusable, and self-service capabilities, enabling application teams to deploy and operate their services without the Platform Engineering organization becoming a central delivery bottleneck.

A central part of the role is to establish clear organizational boundaries between Platform Engineering, application teams, SRE, and Operations. You will help shape a model in which Platform Engineering provides the shared foundation and developer enablement, while application teams remain accountable for the behavior, reliability, and operational outcomes of the services they build.

You will also lead the organization through this transition. Stibo DX is building toward a SaaS-first future while continuing to support self-hosted and hybrid customers. The role therefore requires someone who can balance the target state with pragmatic migration paths, preserving customer value while steadily reducing complexity and fragmentation.

Reporting directly to the CTO and serving both as a member of the Development Leadership Team and the company-wide Senior Leadership Team, you will lead a domain of 14 people and contribute to the continued development of both your domain and the wider engineering organization. The role can be based at any of our Stibo DX offices in Aarhus, Copenhagen, Hamburg, Oslo, or Málaga.

Key responsibilities

You will lead and develop a distributed engineering organization while creating the structure, capabilities, and momentum required to scale Stibo DX’s SaaS transformation. The role combines organizational leadership, platform strategy, developer enablement, and operational discipline, and requires close collaboration with Product Management, Architecture, SRE, Operations, and other engineering leaders.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Lead and develop the distributed Cloud Platform, Print Platform, and Content Delivery teams.

• Build a coherent platform-engineering organization with a shared mission, clear ownership, and strong execution.

• Accelerate the SaaS transformation by translating strategic direction into platform capabilities, adoption paths, and measurable outcomes.

• Provide standardized, reusable, and self-service capabilities that enable application teams to deploy and operate services independently.

• Treat the platform as a product, with clear internal users, priorities, adoption measures, and feedback loops.

• Establish clear boundaries between Platform Engineering, application teams, SRE, Operations, and Architecture.

• Drive platform adoption with the other Development leaders while keeping application migration and operational ownership within the application domains.

• Balance development of the target SaaS platform with pragmatic transition paths for self-hosted and hybrid customers.

• Build a culture of trust, accountability, constructive challenge, continuous improvement, and company-first leadership.

The ideal candidate

You are first and foremost an experienced engineering leader. You know how to create clarity, build effective teams, and translate strategic direction into coordinated execution across a complex engineering domain. You have successfully led distributed engineering teams in an international environment and bring experience from a customer-facing SaaS company or an organization transitioning toward SaaS delivery models.

You understand that developer enablement is how platform engineering scales. You know where a central platform team should build reusable capabilities, where it should provide standards and guardrails, and where application teams must retain ownership. You measure success through adoption and autonomy, not through the amount of work centralized in the platform organization.

You bring sufficient technical depth in platform engineering and SaaS to engage credibly with senior engineers and architects, understand trade-offs, ask incisive questions, guide the overall direction, and recognize whether teams are progressing toward a coherent and scalable platform. You are not expected to be hands-on or to act as the chief platform architect. Your role is to create the conditions for strong technical decisions and hold the organization accountable for sustained progress.

You are a strong people leader known for building trust, developing talent, and creating an environment where accountability, ownership, and continuous learning thrive. You communicate clearly, collaborate naturally across organizational boundaries, and contribute to the success of the wider company rather than focusing only on your own area.

Relevant experience

• Proven leadership experience from platform engineering, cloud-native engineering, developer platforms, or a closely related area.

• Experience leading multiple distributed engineering teams through organizational and technological change.

• Experience with customer-facing SaaS products and the organizational changes required to support SaaS-first delivery models.

• Broad understanding of platform engineering, internal developer platforms, self-service, AWS, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, APIs and gateways, observability, security, reliability, and cloud economics.

• Experience modernizing an established software platform while continuing to support legacy, self-hosted, or hybrid customer environments.

• Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills, with the ability to align across engineering, product, architecture, and operations.

jobs.occupation: AIV Planner - help turn spacecraft assembly into a scalable production flow
jobs.description:
In our Satellite Assembly, Integration, and Verification Team, you will be at the center of planning how spacecraft are assembled, integrated, tested, and tracked. You will translate complex AIV activities into executable production flows and system structures, while coordinating the interfaces that make the flow work in practice. If you combine strong systems understanding with structure, initiative, and a drive to build better solutions, this is your opportunity to shape how we manufacture satellites.

About the Position as AIV Planner

As AIV Planner, you will own the planning framework supporting spacecraft assembly and verification. You will establish and maintain production flows, routings, and planning data in our ERP system while coordinating activities across AIV, production, project management, and logistics to ensure efficient execution.

You will play a key role in developing scalable planning processes, improving digital ways of working, and connecting future ERP and MES capabilities to the needs of spacecraft production. Your experience and ideas will directly influence a more controlled, digital, and scalable production flow.

Responsibilities include:

You will ensure that spacecraft build plans are translated into controlled and executable work in our operational systems, while aligning the interfaces needed for reliable AIV execution.

Production Planning and System Execution

• Create and maintain AIV routings, production orders, planning parameters, and relevant production master data in the ERP system.

• Translate engineering structures and AIV plans into practical production sequences with clear dependencies, revisions, effectivity, and material requirements.

• Monitor order progress and data quality, resolve planning issues, and help establish the ERP system as the operational source of truth for spacecraft build execution.

Cross-functional Planning and Material Flow

• Coordinate with Electronic Production, Project Management, AIV, engineering, warehouse, and other planners to align readiness, priorities, materials, and handovers.

• Coordinate AIV inventory and material flow, including allocation, kitting, shortages, transfers, returns, and controlled movement of hardware.

Configuration, Change, and Improvement

• Maintain configuration and traceability in the ERP system, including correct parts, revisions, serial numbers, routings, effectivity, material movements, and as-built status.

• Assist the ECR/ECO process by identifying affected routings and production orders, supporting change-impact assessment, and implementing approved changes in the ERP system with the required traceability.

What you bring

At GomSpace, it’s not just your technical skills that matter - your character is also important. We value individuals who bring a positive, proactive attitude and can build trust across cultures. The ideal candidate will be comfortable taking ownership in an environment that is still being built, combining a strong systems understanding with practical knowledge of production flows and the ability to quickly learn new tools and processes.

You likely:

• Have minimum 3 years of experience in production planning, working with ERP, MES, or similar operational systems. Experience with IFS is a strong plus, but not mandatory.

• Practical understanding of production flows, routings, production orders, material availability, sequencing, and master data.

• Ability to understand system relationships and translate engineering and operational inputs into a clear, executable production flow.

• Experience with configuration management, revision control, serial-number traceability, and as-built records.

• Ability to coordinate across multiple interfaces and turn incomplete or changing inputs into a structured plan.

• Strong drive, ownership, and a solution-oriented mindset, with the ability to establish and improve processes rather than only operate existing ones.

• Clear written and verbal communication in English.

Here’s why you’ll love working with us:

At GomSpace, we’re on a mission to shape the future of space – one mission at a time. Here, you’ll be part of something bigger than just a project or a product. You’ll help build systems that connect people, enable science and expand humanity’s reach beyond Earth.

We believe the best results come when talented people are trusted, supported, and inspired to push boundaries together.

• Be part of a global company making a real impact in the space industry

• Get freedom under responsibility from day one – and grow with us

• Join a dynamic, full-service environment where no two days are alike

• Work across borders and build a strong international network

• Be part of a culture where collaboration beats competition – and milestones are celebrated together

Join our mission
